text: DSH Canary Decision Proof 是一个供 DSH 使用的工具插件：它注册检查和核验金丝雀判决的工具。用户提供判决清单后，插件检查证据是否完整、时序是否有效、指标样本是否充分，并按策略计算应当暂停、终止或晋级；核验工具还会写入内容寻址报告。适合需要离线复核渐进式发布判决证据的场景。运行需要 Node.js 22 或更高版本，不需要额外密钥或外部服务。

DSH Canary Decision Proof checks canary release evidence against policy. DSH tools inspect manifests and compute pause, abort, or promote; verification can write a content-addressed report. For offline review. Requires Node.js 22 or later.
我想离线检查一次金丝雀发布应该暂停、终止还是晋级。
怎样确认记录下来的发布判决和证据计算结果一致？
需要核对金丝雀与基线指标，并按阈值判断是否中止发布。
DSH Canary Decision Proof 的功能「核验金丝雀判决」：根据清单检查证据并计算应有判决，再比对记录值。调用 dsh_canary_decision_verify，输入清单路径和报告目录，输出核验结果。
DSH Canary Decision Proof 的功能「查看判决摘要」：从清单提取哈希、指标、窗口和观测数量。调用 dsh_canary_decision_inspect，输入清单 JSON 并获取摘要。

dsh-canary-decision-proof README · DSH Canary Decision Proof：**Maintainer / Author：He Fangsheng (贺方升 / 贺去病; also known as Dosen) · [hequbing.com](https://www.hequbing.com)**

Offline, deterministic evidence that a recorded canary `promote`, `abort`, or `pause` decision follows one explicit, hash-only policy.

dsh-canary-decision-proof README · DSH Canary Decision Proof：This plugin **does not execute a rollout, query live metrics, authenticate receipts, grant authorization, prove statistical significance, or prove user outcomes**. It verifies supplied evidence and fails closed to `pause` when that evidence is incomplete.

dsh-canary-decision-proof README · Boundary：- [`dsh-ankh-guard`](https://github.com/Khorsheed/dsh-ankh-guard) supervises a running DSH instance, performs a health canary, and can automatically roll back. This plugin never starts, stops, promotes, or rolls back anything.
- [`dsh-artifact-promotion-proof`](https://github.com/dongsheng123132/dsh-artifact-promotion-proof) proves an ordered artifact promotion chain. This plugin recomputes the decision immediately before such a promotion.
- [`dsh-deployment-rollback-proof`](https://github.com/dongsheng123132/dsh-deployment-rollback-proof) proves last-known-good convergence after failure. This plugin decides whether supplied canary evidence says promote, abort, or pause.
- Argo Rollouts provides a live progressive-delivery controller. This plugin is a controller-neutral, offline evidence verifier.

dsh-canary-decision-proof README · Evidence model：The manifest pins canary and baseline artifact digests, environment, rollout and policy receipts, exact analysis windows, maximum canary traffic, minimum window length, observer threshold, evidence freshness, and metric rules. Every metric requires one baseline and one canary observation in every window.

dsh-canary-decision-proof README · Evidence model：Metric values are positive fixed-point integers (`valueMicros`). For `higher-better`, regression is `(baseline - canary) / baseline`; for `lower-better`, it is `(canary - baseline) / baseline`. Integer basis points make the judgment deterministic. A metric fails when breached windows reach its declared `failureLimit`.

Decision precedence is fixed:

dsh-canary-decision-proof README · Use：```bash
npm test
node bin/dsh-canary-decision-proof.mjs inspect examples/promote.json
node bin/dsh-canary-decision-proof.mjs verify examples/promote.json
```

DSH exposes `dsh_canary_decision_inspect` and `dsh_canary_decision_verify`. The independent stdio MCP server exposes `canary_decision_inspect` and `canary_decision_verify`.

dsh-canary-decision-proof README · Use：The DSH verifier writes only beneath an explicit workspace-relative `artifactDir`, rejects path escape and symlinks, creates a content-addressed report exclusively, and verifies it by read-back. Reports contain hashes, counts, timestamps, fixed-point comparisons, checks and verdicts—not raw business text or secrets.

See [`examples/promote.json`](examples/promote.json) and [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). Node.js 22 or later is required. Licensed under MIT.

dsh-canary-decision-proof README · DSH 金丝雀判决证据：作者 / 维护者：He Fangsheng (贺方升 / 贺去病; also known as Dosen)· [hequbing.com](https://www.hequbing.com)

离线、确定性地复核一份金丝雀发布清单：其中记录的 `promote`、`abort` 或 `pause` 是否必然由同一份显式、仅含哈希的策略与证据推出。

本插件**不执行发布、不查询线上指标、不认证回执、不授予权限、不证明统计显著性，也不证明用户结果正确**。证据缺失、陈旧、错绑、样本不足、暴露流量超限或时间顺序错误时，一律失败闭合到 `pause`。

它与相邻项目互补：`dsh-ankh-guard` 会监督实例、跑健康 canary 并自动回滚，本插件不操作实例；`dsh-artifact-promotion-proof` 证明晋级链，本插件复算晋级前判决；`dsh-deployment-rollback-proof` 证明事故后恢复收敛，本插件只判断当前证据应晋级、终止还是暂停；Argo Rollouts 是线上控制器，本插件是控制器无关的离线证据核验器。

dsh-canary-decision-proof README · DSH 金丝雀判决证据：清单固定 canary/baseline 制品摘要、环境、rollout/policy 回执、精确窗口、最大 canary 流量、最短窗口、观察者阈值、新鲜度和指标规则。每个指标在每个窗口都必须同时有 baseline 与 canary 固定点整数值及样本量。报告只含哈希、计数、时间、比较和判决。

```bash
npm test
node bin/dsh-canary-decision-proof.mjs verify examples/promote.json
```

DSH 工具为 `dsh_canary_decision_inspect` 和 `dsh_canary_decision_verify`；独立 MCP stdio 工具为 `canary_decision_inspect` 和 `canary_decision_verify`。写入仅限显式工作区相对 `artifactDir`，拒绝路径逃逸与符号链接，并执行内容寻址和写后回读验证。
